scope: Homelab: two Windows workstations, one Debian service host, one Proxmox node, one Linux bot host, joined by a Tailscale tailnet and a 198.19.x LAN.

hosts.name: PeeWeeHerman
hosts.notes: Runs the Hermes agent (docker backend), OBS, Discord, Steam. Hosts the sysmon run-state worker.

hosts.name: AireenPC
hosts.notes: Docker engine inside WSL2 (no Docker Desktop). Serves Ollama, Open WebUI and a vLLM container on the tailnet.

hosts.name: RobertDobbs
hosts.notes: Elastic 8.19.24 stack (ES, Kibana, Logstash, Fleet), Grafana/Loki/Prometheus/Alloy, FreeSWITCH.

hosts.name: us-hm-proxmox01
hosts.notes: Shares /data_pool1 over SMB; hosts VMs. SSH from the workstation is source-restricted.

cis.name: PeeWeeHerman Ethernet NIC
cis.notes: Primary LAN uplink; carries agent, OBS and game traffic.

cis.name: AireenPC Ethernet NIC
cis.notes: Inference host uplink; model pulls and tailnet transfers traverse it.

cis.name: RTX 4070 Ti + PSU budget
cis.notes: 320 W board power; run-states change sustained draw materially.

cis.name: RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB
cis.notes: ~15 GB already committed by the resident vLLM model; thermal headroom adequate.

cis.name: Wireless AP coverage
cis.notes: Not yet surveyed; OpenWrt One radios are the anchor.

cis.name: OpenWrt One (MT7981B)
cis.notes: 2.5G + 1G ports; planned VLAN trunk gateway between virtual and physical NICs.

cis.name: Lab VLAN trunk
cis.notes: Trunk carrying management, storage and lab segments to the hypervisor.

cis.name: ARP/NDP caches
cis.notes: Duplicates across LAN and overlay; tailnet handles its own neighbour discovery.

cis.name: Tailnet 100.64.0.0/10
cis.notes: WireGuard mesh, 14 nodes, direct paths preferred; dobbscloudeast offers an exit node.

cis.name: LAN 198.19.0.0/16
cis.notes: Workstations, service host, hypervisor; reachable only from inside.

cis.name: WSL2 NAT 172.29.221.0/24
cis.notes: Container host address space; Windows loopback forwarding bridges it to the host.

cis.name: Docker bridge 172.17.0.0/16
cis.notes: Per-compose networks (aireenpc-ollama_default) sit inside this range.

cis.name: Default route + policy
cis.notes: LAN default via 198.19.6.1; tailnet split routes installed by tailscaled.

cis.name: Ollama API :11434
cis.notes: Container port published on loopback, exposed to the tailnet by tailscale serve.

cis.name: Open WebUI :3000
cis.notes: Chat UI; auth disabled, tailnet-only exposure.

cis.name: vLLM qwen2.5-7b :8080
cis.notes: Holds ~14.9 GB VRAM; must be stopped before ollama can load a 7B.

cis.name: sysmon worker :8765
cis.notes: Run-state API, SSE stream, Prometheus metrics; bearer token off loopback.

cis.name: tailscale serve proxies
cis.notes: No admin rights needed: proxies Windows loopback to the tailnet address.

cis.name: SSH :22
cis.notes: Key-only; the hermes key is source-restricted on the Proxmox host.

cis.name: SMB :445
cis.notes: Q: maps \\198.19.7.20\edrive; a bots share is planned for agent heads and logs.

cis.name: Elasticsearch :9200
cis.notes: Localhost-only with security on; container reports unhealthy. Nothing indexes directly.

cis.name: Agent SSH sessions
cis.notes: Non-interactive, no elevation channel; every remote action is a single command.

cis.name: SMB session to Q:
cis.notes: Remembered connection; bot/log shares fail with WinError 1326 until created.

cis.name: sysmon bearer token
cis.notes: Stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes-sysmon\api_token.txt; only its SHA-256 prefix leaves the box in the head record.

cis.name: sysmon.head/v1 record
cis.notes: Heartbeat every 30 s; local copy always written, SMB rendezvous pending the share.

cis.name: Tailnet HTTPS / certs
cis.notes: Serve currently plain HTTP on the tailnet; HTTPS available when a cert is issued.

cis.name: sysmon JSONL logs
cis.notes: ECS-flavoured NDJSON: @timestamp, event.kind, log.level, host.name, agent.id.

cis.name: GGUF weights (Q4_K_M / Q4_0)
cis.notes: llama3.2:3b, qwen2.5-coder:7b, mistral-7b, dolphin-2.2.1 resident; a converted Q4_K_M in progress.

cis.name: fp16 safetensors (source weights)
cis.notes: 13.5 GB fp16 original of dolphin-2.2.1-AshhLimaRP used for the GGUF conversion.

cis.name: Ollama 0.40.18
cis.notes: GPU-backed; embeddings served from nomic-embed-text at 100% GPU.

cis.name: Open WebUI 0.13.5
cis.notes: Model picker and chat over the Ollama backend.

cis.name: Elastic Stack 8.19.24
cis.notes: Kibana and Fleet reachable; ES unhealthy and localhost-bound — shipping path is Logstash or an Agent.

cis.name: Grafana 13.2.5
cis.notes: Dashboards over Prometheus/Loki; the natural wall for agent status links.

cis.name: hermes-win11-ops:sysmon
cis.notes: Run-state worker: manifests, gates, read-back verify, STOP, live dashboard.

cis.name: Hermes agent
cis.notes: Docker-backed assistant; also drives deploys like this CMDB.

cis.name: Zeppo Discord bot
cis.notes: Locked to a single Discord user; voice variant pending.
